description: This file is a PHP script that generates an HTML page for editing Dynamic DNS (DDNS) settings. It includes server-side PHP code to retrieve current DDNS configuration, and client-side JavaScript for form validation, dynamic UI interactions, and AJAX submission.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Dynamically adds a new host name input field to the form.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes a host name input field from the form.
